refresh_policy.rationale: Collection reads the cycles, recoveries, sleeps and workouts that app.whoop.com loads for the owner's own signed-in session, from inside that page. The first run and an expired session need the owner to sign in through the browser handoff. The first run reads the account's history in thirty-day windows; later runs re-read the last week, which WHOOP may still be scoring, and continue from there. Requests go one at a time with pauses.

streams.name: cycles
streams.description: WHOOP physiological cycles: each runs from one sleep's start to the next, with its day strain, energy and heart rate.

display.label: Your WHOOP cycles
display.detail: Each cycle's start and end, strain, energy and heart rate.

id.description: WHOOP's cycle id. Recoveries share it; sleeps and workouts carry it as cycle_id.

start_at.description: When the cycle began, at the onset of the sleep that opens it (RFC 3339, UTC).

end_at.description: When the cycle ended (RFC 3339, UTC); null for the cycle still under way.

day.description: The calendar day WHOOP assigns the cycle, in the owner's local time.

timezone_offset.description: The owner's UTC offset during the cycle, as +HH:MM or -HH:MM.

strain.description: Day strain on WHOOP's 0 to 21 scale; null while WHOOP has not scored it.

kilojoules.description: Energy expended over the cycle, in kilojoules.

average_heart_rate.description: Average heart rate over the cycle, in beats per minute.

max_heart_rate.description: Highest heart rate over the cycle, in beats per minute.

streams.name: recoveries
streams.description: WHOOP recovery for each cycle, scored from the sleep that opens it: recovery score, heart rate variability, resting heart rate, blood oxygen and skin temperature.

display.label: Your WHOOP recoveries
display.detail: Recovery score, HRV, resting heart rate, SpO2 and skin temperature for each cycle.

id.description: The id of the cycle this recovery belongs to; one recovery per cycle.

start_at.description: When the cycle began (RFC 3339, UTC): the onset of the sleep this recovery was scored from.

sleep_id.description: The sleep this recovery was scored from, matching sleeps.id.

recovery_score.description: Recovery score, a percentage from 0 to 100.

hrv_rmssd_ms.description: Heart rate variability as RMSSD, in milliseconds.

resting_heart_rate.description: Resting heart rate, in beats per minute.

spo2_percentage.description: Blood oxygen saturation, as a percentage; null where the strap does not measure it.

streams.name: sleeps
streams.description: WHOOP sleeps, naps included: when each began and ended, its sleep-stage durations, sleep performance and respiratory rate.

display.label: Your WHOOP sleeps
display.detail: Sleep and nap times, stage durations, sleep performance and respiratory rate.

cycle_id.description: The cycle this sleep belongs to, matching cycles.id.

timezone_offset.description: The owner's UTC offset during the sleep, as +HH:MM or -HH:MM.

is_nap.description: Whether WHOOP counts this sleep as a nap.

performance_percentage.description: Sleep performance: the sleep obtained as a percentage of the sleep needed.

respiratory_rate.description: Respiratory rate during the sleep, in breaths per minute.

awake_ms.description: Time awake while in bed, in milliseconds.

streams.name: workouts
streams.description: WHOOP workouts and other activities: when each began and ended, its sport, strain, energy and heart rate.

display.label: Your WHOOP workouts
display.detail: Activity times, sport, strain, energy and heart rate.

cycle_id.description: The cycle this workout belongs to, matching cycles.id.

timezone_offset.description: The owner's UTC offset during the workout, as +HH:MM or -HH:MM.

sport_id.description: WHOOP's sport id: -1 is a generic activity, 0 is running.

strain.description: Workout strain on WHOOP's 0 to 21 scale.

kilojoules.description: Energy expended during the workout, in kilojoules.

average_heart_rate.description: Average heart rate during the workout, in beats per minute.

max_heart_rate.description: Highest heart rate during the workout, in beats per minute.

reason_display_messages.collection_interrupted: WHOOP stopped answering partway through, so some records are missing. The next run continues from where this one stopped.
reason_display_messages.sign_in_required: WHOOP needs you to sign in again before this can continue.
reason_display_messages.source_limit_reached: This run read as much WHOOP history as one run allows. The next run continues from where this one stopped.
reason_display_messages.source_unreadable: WHOOP answered with something this connector doesn't recognise, so nothing more was read. WHOOP may have changed its app; please report this rather than retrying.
